execution.prompt_precedence: Three-line verify-then-revise uses its own output format in lieu of the one-line no-think contract. The think standalone task still requests explicit Verdict and BrokenStep before the final option.
execution.generation_processor: vLLM model generation config defaults + explicit protocol sampling overrides
execution.raw_logit_method: Replay actual token prefix up to each generated field colon. At temperature 0 with no penalties, retain allowed candidate logits using processed_logits. Missing or non-token-aligned fields carry explicit status.
execution.natural_turn1_correct: at least three of four samples on the corresponding context; per-sample outcome for bare turn 1
execution.prompt_failure_transfer: Unparsed call-1 fields transmit the literal UNPARSED. Raw outputs and parse status are retained.
execution.natural_seed_arms: Six supplied core arms; apply frozen symbolic rhetoric/source/P0 wrappers verbatim and neutral no-new-facts confirmation for I0. NAT-001 false-update gold is D; ITT initial/target labels remain B/A; report natural results descriptively.
execution.analysis: Set thresholds use samples 0-3. G1 combines held-out dialog rates with the fraction meeting the defined standalone paired-ok criterion. Evaluation tables use samples 4-7. Logit associations target induced_target among parseable final choices with available scores. Intervals resample families 4000 times, seed 12827; natural items use base ID.
